name: Franchising
revenueModel: Same cost as other modes — you choose $M on Decision. Fees and royalty only.
notes: About 20 franchised outlets per $1 M. Fit for unstable or hostile markets.

name: Joint Venture
revenueModel: Same cost as other modes — 50% share with a local partner.
notes: About 8 outlets per $1 M at 50% share. Fit for distant cultures and high barriers.

name: Wholly Owned Subsidiary
revenueModel: Same cost as other modes — you own and run the outlets.
notes: About 4 own outlets per $1 M. Fit for stable, familiar markets.
